main_text.p: [?]φη, καθὼς γέγραπται, respicit id quod scrip-ptū alibi dianoëticè & quoad sensum tan-tùm. ii.ex verbis λαλῶν περὶ τότων i.e. eodē de argumento, quod non idè ac si dixisset λαλῶν οὕτως, vel λαλῶν τύπος. iii. ex eo, quod hæc ipsa in omnibus Paulinis scripta esse memorat; Atqui frustra totidem verbis in iisdem reperiri arbitreris. iv. Quia de convenientia scriptionis, ex identitate mate-riæ & scopi, nó verborum dijudicandum. v. quia Petrus id scriptū dicit simpliciter, non quomodo scriptū, & quibus verbis, ré affirmat nó modum rei. Diversimode autē rem eandem exprimi quid vetat? Respon-demus ii. peccari elencho oppositorū & divisionis, dū opponitur & dividitur scopus utriusq; scriptoris, qui reverà non disjun-gi sed conjungi, subordinari debet nó co-ordinari, ut ex ante dictis liquet. Et mu-niuntur Hebræi ab utroque adversus seductionem, impatientiam, diffidentiā.

VI. Secundam, quod attinet, instantiā, 1. peccatur paralogismo ἀγνοίας ἐλέγχου; nec negamus, eadem in aliis Pauli Epistolis, & si verba spectamus, forte expressius repeti-imò affirmat Petrus, ὡς [?]ἐν πάσαις ἐπιστολαῖς.

page.notes: Greek in the first line of the page is partly unclear; the opening word and "τότων" (for τούτων) are as printed or doubtful, marked [?]. The Greek at the end of the page is also doubtful. Running head "ad Hebræos." and page number 43 are printed at the top. The catchword "Suffi-" is printed at the foot right. No marginal notes are printed.
